subject: Kary
text: Kary resists fire, halving damage from elemental resistance and halving it again by failing the magic resistance check, resulting in Fire dealing roughly 5-10, Fir2 dealing 15-30, and Fir3 dealing 25-50 damage.

evidence.quote: The main issue is that Kary resists fire, so your spell's damage range is going to get halved by the elemental resistance, and then halved again by the fact that your spell is not going to pass the magic resistance check. This means Fire's damage range is roughly 5-10, Fir2 only manages 15-30, and Fir3 can get around 25-50.

subject: Kary
text: To defeat Kary with fire damage without the Flame Sword, players can slug it out until Kary has taken 500+ damage and then stall until finishing her off with fire magic.

evidence.quote: You'll be focusing on slugging it out until Kary's taken 500+ damage and then stalling until you can manage to do enough damage with fire magic to finish her off.

subject: Flame Sword
text: The Flame Sword has 26-attack-power but functions as generic sword damage because its elemental alignment property does not function correctly, allowing a Fighter, Red Mage, or Ninja to defeat Kary with it.

evidence.quote: If you *have* been to the Ice Cave already, your Fighter/Red Mage/Ninja can swing a Flame Sword. This weapon, like all other weapons that are supposed to be elementally aligned or super-effective against a family of monsters, is instead entirely generic because its special property doesn't function correctly, so you won't be doing any less damage than with any other 26-attack-power sword; just buff up your sword wielder of choice (as long as you didn't choose Thief, because they don't get to equip it until after class changing) and swing until you win.

subject: Ice Cave
text: To reach the Ice Cave from Crescent Lake port, sail north to dock or enter the river, head west by canoe into the interior, take the north path at the four-way river intersection, turn east at the fork, continue west around the corner, take the west fork, and head south.

evidence.quote: Sail north from the Crescent Lake port and either dock at the next port up or just sail directly into the river in the bay; either way you'll be getting on your canoe to head west into the interior of the continent again. From the four-way river intersection, head north, go east at the next fork, continue around the corner and keep west, take the west fork when you get to it, and continue south around the next corner to arrive at the Ice Cave.

subject: Floor 1
text: The first floor of the Ice Cave has nothing immediately accessible, requiring players to take the stairs down to Floor 2 (west).

evidence.quote: Ice Cave's first floor has nothing immediately accessible, so take the stairs down to Floor 2 (west).

subject: Floor 2 (west)
text: Proceed to the bottom left corner of Floor 2 (west) to reach Floor 3 (East).

evidence.quote: Nothing interesting here either, just proceed to the bottom left corner of the floor to reach Floor 3 (East).

subject: Floor 3 (East)
text: Floor 3 (East) contains two sets of stairs leading up, where taking the stairs not previously used leads to Floor 2 (east).

evidence.quote: This room's just two sets of stairs up, so go to the ones you didn't come from. This will lead to Floor 2 (east).

subject: Floor 2 (east)
text: Walking around the holes in the interior treasure room of Floor 2 (east) to the top-left chest awards the Flame Sword.

evidence.quote: The interior treasure room of this floor has 3 treasure chests, but you're only going to be able to grab two of them coming from this entrance; walking around the holes to the top-left chest will earn you the Flame Sword (which, if you haven't beaten Kary yet, could be taken out of here and used to fight her more conveniently as long as you have somebody who can wield it).

subject: Floor 2 (east)
text: The top-right chest in the Floor 2 (east) treasure room contains Clothes, guarded by a forced encounter with Mages.

evidence.quote: Going around to the top-right chest will result in a forced encounter with some Mages (particularly nasty random encounter foes) and a chest that contains Clothes (particularly insulting reward for the trouble).

subject: Floor 2 (east)
text: Stepping into any pit in the treasure room of Floor 2 (east) drops the party into the starting room of Floor 3 (West).

evidence.quote: In order to get that last one, you'll have to step into one of the pits in the treasure room, which all land in the same place: the starting room of Floor 3 (West).

subject: Floor 3 (West)
text: The room west of the starting room on Floor 3 (West) contains 2 chests holding a Silver Gauntlet and Ice Armor, guarded by a forced encounter with 1 to 2 Frost D.

evidence.quote: Floor 3 (West) has a couple more treasure rooms in it, one to the west of the starting room (2 chests, Silver Gauntlet, Ice Armor, guarded by forced encounter with Frost D x1-2) and one at the far south of this floor (6 chests, 7900 G, 5450 G, 180 G, 9900 G, 5000 G, 12350 G, forced FrWolf gang encounter between the two right side chests).

subject: Floor 3 (West)
text: The treasure room at the far south of Floor 3 (West) contains 6 chests with 7900 G, 5450 G, 180 G, 9900 G, 5000 G, and 12350 G, with a forced FrWolf gang encounter between the two right chests.

evidence.quote: Floor 3 (West) has a couple more treasure rooms in it, one to the west of the starting room (2 chests, Silver Gauntlet, Ice Armor, guarded by forced encounter with Frost D x1-2) and one at the far south of this floor (6 chests, 7900 G, 5450 G, 180 G, 9900 G, 5000 G, 12350 G, forced FrWolf gang encounter between the two right side chests).

subject: Floor 1 (West)
text: Floor 1 (West) contains 5 chests containing a Heal potion, 10000 G, 9500 G, a Tent, and an Ice Shield, as well as a hole to drop through.

evidence.quote: The stairs up are at the southeast part of the room, leading back to Floor 1 but in the west portion this time. This part of the floor has 5 total chests (Heal potion, 10000 G, 9500 G, Tent, Ice Shield) and a hole to drop through.

subject: Floor 2 (East)
text: Dropping down the pit in Floor 1 (West) lands the party on Floor 2 (East) in front of the required chest containing the Floater, guarded by an Eye.

evidence.quote: Going down this pit will lead you to Floor 2 (East) again, placed in a position to go grab the **required** chest containing the Floater; you'll have to fight an Eye when you step in front of the chest.

subject: Floor 2 (East)
text: To exit the Ice Cave after obtaining the Floater, fall down the pit in Floor 2 (East) to reach Floor 3 (West), navigate to Floor 1 (West), and climb the stairs in the top-right corner.

evidence.quote: Getting back out after getting the Floater will be a process; you'll have to fall down a pit in this room again to get back to Floor 3 (West), make it through that floor again, take the stairs back up to Floor 1 (West), and take the stairs leading up in the top-right corner of this area to leave the cave.

subject: Airship
text: Using the Floater summons the Airship, allowing players to fight Kary, Kraken, and Tiamat in any order without defeating further bosses to access the world.

evidence.quote: After using the Floater to summon the Airship [achievement 3576], you technically don't have to defeat any further bosses to open up the rest of the game world; the chain of progression items implies you should defeat the fiend of water and then the fiend of wind, but you can fight Kary, Kraken and Tiamat in any order if you wish.

subject: Cardia Caves
text: The Cardia island caves contain 13 chests across 3 caves, including one cave holding a Cabin, 575 G, and a Soft potion.

evidence.quote: There are 13 chests in total, spread across 3 caves (one with Cabin, 575 G, and Soft potion; one with 10 G, House, and 500 G; and a last one with 160 G, 9500 G, 2750 G, 1520 G, another 2750 G, 2000 G, and 1455 G).

subject: Cardia Caves
text: A second cave in the Cardia Isles contains 3 chests holding 10 G, a House, and 500 G.

evidence.quote: There are 13 chests in total, spread across 3 caves (one with Cabin, 575 G, and Soft potion; one with 10 G, House, and 500 G; and a last one with 160 G, 9500 G, 2750 G, 1520 G, another 2750 G, 2000 G, and 1455 G).

subject: Cardia Caves
text: A third cave in the Cardia Isles holds 7 chests containing 160 G, 9500 G, 2750 G, 1520 G, another 2750 G, 2000 G, and 1455 G.

evidence.quote: There are 13 chests in total, spread across 3 caves (one with Cabin, 575 G, and Soft potion; one with 10 G, House, and 500 G; and a last one with 160 G, 9500 G, 2750 G, 1520 G, another 2750 G, 2000 G, and 1455 G).

subject: Bahamut
text: Bahamut is located in the Cardia Isles cave featuring a long hallway with a staircase leading down at the end.

evidence.quote: Find Bahamut in the Cardia Isles cave that's a long hallway with a staircase leading down at the end; if you have the Tail on hand, he'll grant your party a class upgrade, giving them the ability to use high-level equipment, the power to use magic (for knights and ninjas) or the higher tiers of magic that have thus far been inaccessible (for the mage classes), and the Black Belt gets... a different outfit, mostly.

subject: Tail
text: Presenting the Tail from the Castle of Ordeals to King Bahamut grants the party a class upgrade.

evidence.quote: If you went out and got the Tail from the Castle of Ordeals, here's where you can turn in that seemingly important but also seemingly useless sidequest reward... if you have the Tail on hand, he'll grant your party a class upgrade, giving them the ability to use high-level equipment, the power to use magic (for knights and ninjas) or the higher tiers of magic that have thus far been inaccessible (for the mage classes), and the Black Belt gets... a different outfit, mostly.

subject: Don't Change For Anyone
text: Completing the class change sidequest with King Bahamut locks out the Don't Change For Anyone achievement.

evidence.quote: Doing this last step of the class change sidequest before Don't Change For Anyone [achievement 398475] will stop that achievement.

subject: Magic Shops
text: Magic levels 1 through 6 are sold across Coneria (level 1), Pravoka (level 2), Elfland (levels 3 and 4), Melmond (level 5), and Crescent Lake (level 6).

evidence.quote: The first 6 levels of magic were buyable before having the airship - level 1 in Coneria, level 2 in Pravoka, levels 3 and 4 in Elfland, level 5 in Melmond, level 6 in Crescent Lake.

subject: Level 7 Magic
text: Level 7 spells are sold between Gaia and Onrac, both requiring flight by airship to access.

evidence.quote: Level 7 spells are split between Gaia, a town in the mountains at the northeast corner of the world map only accessible by flight, and Onrac, which is on the eastern edge of the continent to the west of the Cardia Isles (also requiring flight to get to).

subject: Level 8 Magic
text: Gaia sells three level 8 white and black magic spells each, while Lefein offers Lif2 for White Wizards and Nuke for Black Wizards.

evidence.quote: Gaia sells three level 8 white and black magic spells each. However, if you fill up here you'll be missing out on the fourth options Lefein offers, which are Lif2 for the White Wizard (fully revives a fallen ally outside of combat, could do literally anything and would be a superior option to Xfer which does nothing) and Nuke for the Black Wizard (deals significant, reliable damage; all the level 8 black spells in Gaia are gimmicky instakills).

subject: Waterfall Cave
text: To reach Waterfall Cave, fly west from Cardia Isles to Onrac's continent, land on the bright green grass at the south end, and canoe straight up the river into the waterfall.

evidence.quote: Flying west from the Cardia Isles will bring us to the continent that Onrac is located in. Land on the patch of brighter green grass at the south end and canoe up the river; this time it's just a straight shot to the waterfall, and canoeing into it will put you in Waterfall Cave.

subject: Waterfall Cave
text: The southwest treasure room of Waterfall Cave contains 6 chests containing a Wizard Staff, Ribbon, 13450 G, 6400 G, 5000 G, and a Defense sword.

evidence.quote: Waterfall Cave is basically just a long series of blocky intersections with a treasure room located at the southwest corner. Walking through the door will result in a fight with a mob of annoying but individually weak enemies which you can blast with spells at your leisure; the room contains 6 chests (Wizard Staff, Ribbon, 13450 G, 6400 G, 5000 G, Defense sword).

subject: Robot
text: Talking to the robot inside the southwest treasure room of Waterfall Cave yields the Cube.

evidence.quote: It also contains some sort of weird robot; you'll have to talk to it to obtain the Cube, then leave.

subject: Bottled Fairy
text: Purchasing the Bottled Fairy from the caravan west of Onrac and releasing it into the springs at Gaia rewards the party with Oxyale, allowing access to the submarine at Onrac.

evidence.quote: We've got no immediate options of things to do that don't require going to the Sea Shrine now, so purchase the Bottled Fairy from the caravan west of Onrac, release it in the springs at Gaia to receive Oxyale [achievement 3578], and go back to Onrac to take the submarine down to the Sea Shrine.

subject: Floor 3 (West)
text: Floor 3 (West) of the Sea Shrine contains two immediately available chests holding 9900 G and 2000 G.

evidence.quote: You enter the Sea Shrine on Floor 3 (West). There are two immediately available chests here (9900 G, 2000 G).

subject: Floor 2
text: The main portion of Floor 2 in the Sea Shrine contains 5 chests holding Opal Armor, 20 G, a Light Axe, a Mage Staff, and 12350 G.

evidence.quote: This brings you to the main portion of Floor 2, which contains 5 more treasures scattered around the rooms (Opal Armor, 20 G, Light Axe, Mage Staff, 12350 G).

subject: Floor 1
text: The northeast treasure room of Floor 1 in the Sea Shrine contains 3 chests holding an Opal Helmet, Opal Armor, and the required Slab.

evidence.quote: The treasure room that's only accessible from here contains 3 chests. The left one is an Opal Helmet, the middle one is Opal Armor, and the right one is the **Slab**, which you must get in order to unlock the next dungeon.

subject: Floor 1
text: Floor 1 of the Sea Shrine contains 10 additional chests holding 2750 G, 10000 G, 10 G, 4150 G, 5000 G, 9000 G, 1760 G, Opal Bracelet, Pure potion, and Opal Shield.

evidence.quote: After that, you can go back around the passage and collect the other 10 chests at your leisure (2750 G, 10000 G, 10 G, 4150 G, 5000 G, 9000 G, 1760 G, Opal Bracelet, Pure potion, Opal Shield).

subject: Dr. Unne
text: Taking the Slab to an NPC in Melmond allows the party to learn the language of Lefein and acquire the Chime.

evidence.quote: At this point, you don't actually need to finish the dungeon; once you have the Slab, you can learn the language of Lefein [achievement 3651] from an NPC in Melmond. Doing so will enable you to grab the Chime from Lefein and access the next dungeon, as well as hit up the last two magic shops in the game (see earlier notes on Of Mighty Magic [achievement 27656]).

subject: Floor 3 (East)
text: Floor 3 (East) of the Sea Shrine contains 2 chests out in the open holding 110 G and 450 G.

evidence.quote: Taking these will put you on Floor 2; walk around the square island to take another set of down stairs and enter Floor 3 (East), a relatively small area with 2 chests out in the open (110 G, 450 G).

subject: Floor 4 (West)
text: Floor 4 (West) of the Sea Shrine contains four treasure rooms holding a Ribbon, 9900 G, 7340 G, 2750 G, Light Axe, 7690 G, 8135 G, 5450 G, 385 G, and Power Gauntlet.

evidence.quote: Floor 4 (West) has four treasure rooms; the northeast one has 4 chests (Ribbon, 9900 G, 7340 G, 2750 G), the northwest one has one chest (Light Axe), southeast has 2 chests (7690 G, 8135 G), and southwest has 3 chests (5450 G, 385 G, Power Gauntlet).

subject: Kraken
text: Floor 5 of the Sea Shrine contains the path leading directly to the fiend Kraken.

evidence.quote: Floor 5 looks like it might have something to it, but there's nothing interesting except the path up to Kraken [achievement 3579].
